en.title: Pronouncing Ce in Romanian Questions
en.summary: Learn how to pronounce the short Romanian question word ce clearly and naturally when you ask questions.

sections.title: The sound
paragraphs: The question word (ce) /tʃe/ means what. It starts with a sound like 'ch' in 'check'. The vowel is like the 'e' in 'bed'. Together, you say /tʃe/. Listen to the phrase (ce faci) /tʃe ˈfatʃʲ/, which means what are you doing. The sound is crisp and quick.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Touch your tongue behind your top front teeth. Release the air quickly to make the first sound. Then, open your mouth a little for the vowel. Keep your lips relaxed and flat. Do not push your lips forward. Keep the vowel very short. Let your voice rise slightly to show a question.

sections.title: Reading rules
paragraphs: The letters c and e always make this sound together. When you see them at the start of a sentence, say /tʃe/. In questions, this word never takes heavy stress. Instead, the stress jumps forward to the next word. Look at (ce faci) /tʃe ˈfatʃʲ/. Here, your voice stresses (faci) /ˈfatʃʲ/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not say a hard sound like 'k'. Do not pronounce it like 's' either. Another mistake is making the vowel too long. Some people say 'chay', like in 'say'. Never add that gliding sound at the end. Keep it short, flat, and light. Move your voice quickly to the next word.
